name: COVID Flu RSV Wastewater Levels MCP
description: CDC NWSS wastewater viral activity levels for COVID-19, flu and RSV by US state and county, plus emergency department respiratory illness activity and national test positivity (data.cdc.gov). Tools: covid_flu_rsv_levels_state, covid_flu_rsv_levels_county, covid_flu_rsv_levels_national, covid_flu_rsv_compare_states. Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint, no account or API key.
author: theluckystrike
